text_block_list.text: The day of King Halo's debut race has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
I'll be the very first to make my debut!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, did you know? Apparently neither Sky-san
nor Special Week-san have had their debut race yet!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-ich-means~... the very first thing everyone sees
will be King's magnificent running form♪

Amidst all this, a certain voice came from
the television in the green room.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Man... that was truly a masterpiece!
Grass Wonder, who just made her debut the other day!"

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
"Right! The way Grass Wonder runs!
Once you see it, you can never forget it...!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
choice_data_list: Go out there and show them a winning run!
Go out there and run a race you won't lose!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grass-san might have made her debut, sure!?
Well, as of today, I'm making my debut too, you know!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show you a run so dazzling
it'll completely rewrite everyone's memories!
